title: Demo Backlog and Unfinished Projects
dataSources: Practice sessions (`practice:session`), DAW sessions (`daw:session`), release/streaming stats (`release:stats`), gig setlists (`setlist:play`).
app: Music and creator telemetry — practice-tracker apps (Modacity), DAW project logs, and streaming/creator analytics (Spotify for Artists, YouTube Studio) — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=daw:session project_status!=finished
| stats count as sessions, latest(last_touched_days) as last_touched_days by project_name project_status
| sort - last_touched_days
description: Lists unfinished DAW projects and how long they have been waiting for attention.
value: A demo backlog is normal, but neglected projects pile up faster than most creators realise.
implementation: Track DAW sessions with project name and status; review unfinished work by age since last touch.
visualization: Project table of unfinished demos ranked by days since last touched.
grandmaExplanation: It warns which music projects are still unfinished and how long they have been sitting there waiting.
